description.blurb: This moon of Jupiter, like many others, was discovered in February or March 2003 at the Mauna Kea Observatory in Hawaii.
description.more: This satellite has a mean radius of 1 km, assuming an albedo of 0.04. At a mean distance of about 18 million miles (28.3 million kilometers) from Jupiter, the satellite takes about 979 Earth days to complete one orbit.
